clusters.description:
Reading: FieldReplaceablePart(s).Belt -[is part of]-> CuttingDeck(s).PartCarrier.

Belt end — role: Field-Replaceable Part, multiplicity 0..2
(a CuttingDeck may carry no belt (0) — e.g. during replacement —
one belt on a standard deck (1),
or two belts on a dual-drive deck (2).)

CuttingDeck end — role: Part Carrier, multiplicity 0..1
(a Belt belongs to at most one CuttingDeck at a time,
or exists freely as a spare (0).)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
The Belt is a Line-Replaceable Unit (LRU).
A Belt can exist independently of any CuttingDeck.

Reading: FieldReplaceablePart(s).Blade -[is part of]-> CuttingDeck(s).PartCarrier.

Blade end — role: Field-Replaceable Part, multiplicity 0..1
(a CuttingDeck may carry no blade (0) — during replacement or servicing —
or one blade on a standard deck (1).)

CuttingDeck end — role: Part Carrier, multiplicity 0..1
(a Blade belongs to at most one CuttingDeck at a time,
or exists freely as a spare (0).)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
The Blade is a Line-Replaceable Unit (LRU).
A Blade can exist independently of any CuttingDeck.

Reading: FieldReplaceablePart(s).Belt -[is part of]-> Transmission(s).PartCarrier.

Belt end — role: Field-Replaceable Part, multiplicity 0..2
(a Transmission may carry no belt (0), one belt (1), or two belts (2).)

Transmission end — role: Part Carrier, multiplicity 0..1
(a Belt belongs to at most one Transmission at a time,
or exists freely as a spare (0).)

Aggregation semantics (hollow diamond):
The Belt is a Line-Replaceable Unit (LRU).
The same belt type that fits the CuttingDeck also fits the Transmission.

Reading: IntegralAssembly(ies).CuttingDeck -[contains]-> LawnMower.EndItem.

CuttingDeck end — role: Integral Assembly, multiplicity 0..2
(a LawnMower may have no cutting deck (0) — e.g. stripped unit in transit —
one deck on a single-deck mower (1),
or two decks on a dual-deck mower (2).)

LawnMower end — role: End Item, multiplicity 1 (default, not shown)
(a CuttingDeck belongs to exactly one LawnMower.)

Composition semantics (filled diamond):
The CuttingDeck is an Integral Assembly — a Shop-Replaceable Unit (SRU).
The CuttingDeck cannot exist independently of the LawnMower in this model.

Reading: IntegralAssembly(ies).Transmission -[contains]-> LawnMower.EndItem.

Transmission end — role: Integral Assembly, multiplicity 0..1
(a LawnMower has exactly one Transmission (1) in normal configuration,
or none (0) if stripped for transport or overhaul.)

LawnMower end — role: End Item, multiplicity 1 (default, not shown)
(a Transmission belongs to exactly one LawnMower.)

Composition semantics (filled diamond):
The Transmission is an Integral Assembly — a Shop-Replaceable Unit (SRU).
The farmer does not remove or service the transmission in the field.
